name: bartender
description: Interactive cocktail recipes (IBA official list) with a REST API, an MCP server and a web app.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bartender/core && npm run build -w @bartender/api -w @bartender/mcp -w @bartender/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @bartender/api & npm run dev -w @bartender/web; wait
